newsitem.title: USA: Fed stays out of market, but high add need seen.
newsitem.headline: Fed stays out of market, but high add need seen.

text.p: The Federal Reserve stayed on the sidelines for the second say in a row Tuesday, but the high add need makes it likely the Fed will add reserves Wednesday, anlaysts said.
Keeping the Fed out of the market Tuesday, analysts said, was the soft federal funds level of 5-1/8 percent.

With Wednesday the final day of the maintenence period, and the Fed facing a projected $5-6.5 billion add need, most agree that the Fed will inject reserves Wednesday. In addition, players expect a bill pass Wednesday as well.
